product_summary: Trader-retailer (IndiaMART profile: 'Nature of Business: Trader - Retailer', additional wholesale/retail/warehouse) established 2004, Pune (Bhosari MIDC / Pimpri-Bhosari Road), proprietor Aliasgar Vadnagarwala. Authorised dealer for Polyhose, Hydax, Hydromax, Polyhydron, Dowty, Bosch Rexroth, KBL, JELPC Pneumatics, Hydroline. Real catalogue per own site: hydraulic valves (directional control, pressure relief, pressure reducing, flow control, flow divider, modular flow control, check, needle, shut-off, proportional), hydraulic pumps (gear pumps Dowty/Rexroth, single and double vane pumps Veljan Denison, radial piston pumps Polyhydron, HP 5012-ST), hydraulic hoses (Polyhose R1AT 1SN, air hose, non-conductive, thermoplastic, high-pressure, paint spray hose), filters and tank accessories (line filter, suction strainer, spin-on filter, ABT die-cast breather), fittings and couplings (Hyloc welding nipple, bulkhead pipe couplings, tube couplings, PU tube, pipe clamps), gear couplings (Hydax), pressure switches and gauge indicators. No electrical control panels, PLCs, switchgear or boards of any kind appear in the catalogue.
comment: HS 853710 (boards/panels for electric control, ≤1000 V) is not corroborated by any product on the company's own site — the entire range is hydraulic/pneumatic fluid-power components and hoses. Industry claimed as 'Энергетика' (power/energy) is a misclassification: the actual industry is fluid-power distribution (hydraulic and pneumatic components trading). Corrected codes: 848120 for the valve line (the dominant declared product), 841360 for pumps, 400931/400932 for hoses, 730799 for steel fittings, 848360 for gear couplings, 842129 for filters, 902620 for gauges. Trader signs are explicit and self-declared (Trader - Retailer, authorised dealer of third-party brands, no own brand in the catalogue; the 'we manufacture' wording on the About page contradicts the IndiaMART 'Trader - Retailer' classification and the dealer list, so it is not treated as manufacturing evidence). Product lines missing from the declaration: hoses, fittings/couplings, filters, gear couplings, pressure gauges — i.e. the declaration covers at most one of roughly six product families. Per project rule 3 the HS mismatch does not reject the company; verdict is accepted with HS corrected. All product data here is from the company's own website/IndiaMART profile only — no customs line was checked in this task, so the export claim ('we export to Saudi Arabia, UAE') and all shipment activity are 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. No registry, revenue or customs-volume research was performed (out of scope for this role); PAN/CIN not verified.
